programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E02 — Bewilderment
Masane, reborn a furious force of nature, gets conscripted into service by the Doji Group; while the reality of Masane's new life sets in, her daughter Rihoko wanders Tokyo alone.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E03 — Defiance
The Doji Group wants Masane to deal with the rogue X-Cons stalking the streets of Tokyo; in exchange for her work, Takayama guarantees Masane a new life with her daughter.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E04 — Movement
Masane's role as the Doji Group's weapon comes with a new home, but security and comfort fade when she learns another powerful entity, the NSWF, seeks possession of the Witchblade.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E05 — Search
Masane can finally provide for Rihoko after pressing the Doji Group for a new salary; the peace of mind might not last now that a reporter named Tozawa follows a new lead: the Witchblade.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E06 — Change
The Doji Group rescues Masane from the ravaging hands of her clone contemporaries; as she gets whisked away, a savage assailant gives chase.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E07 — Past
After Shiori's sanity crumbles, she attacks the ship carrying Masane; when the battle ends, the true destiny of those who bear the blade comes into harsh focus.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E08 — Reciprocity
A new model of X-Con kills in ways that none have before, and with Masane along for the ride, Tozawa becomes a willing participant in the hunt for the monsters.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E09 — Sadness
Tozawa and Masane investigate a strange string of murders, and hope the crimes have no relation to the lonely man recently befriended by Rihoko.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E10 — Interaction
After Masane gets spotted during a fight, she must attend a fancy dinner party as punishment.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E14 — Family
As Reina and Rihoko's relationship suffers, Masane's mental state suffers too; Maria rises to the challenge and embraces the Cloneblades.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E15 — Bonds
Reina and Masane rush to save Rihoko from Maria's jealous rage, but the action unfortunately attracts the attention of every X-Con for miles around.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:

As the residents of the Natsuki Building head off for the beach, Takayama warns Masane that Witchblade and Cloneblade alike take severe tolls on the life of the bearer.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E17 — Confusion
Takayama struggles to maintain the upper hand against his rival, Wado; Tozawa digs up all the dirt he can on Father; the Cloneblade project may have goals more sinister than mere profit.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E18 — Turn
Takayama resigns after claiming responsibility for several high-profile incidents, leaving the Doji Group in Wado's hands; Maria takes over training the new generation of Cloneblades.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E19 — Feelings
Masane and Takayama grow closer after she reaches new levels of lust and rage to protect him; at the NSWF, Father's joy proves short-lived when his latest Cloneblade stages a coup.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E20 — Request
Takayama offers reassurance that he will look out for Rihoko if Masane falls in battle; Maria grows even more focused on claiming the Witchblade for herself.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E21 — Vow
Struggling under the emotional and physical strain of the Witchblade, Masane looks for ways to remove the artifact, but nothing short of death can remove the curse.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E22 — Inform
A tender moment between Masane and Rihoko gets interrupted by attacking X-Cons; Maria chooses the next Sister to take on the Witchblade; more trouble approaching from offshore.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E23 — Chaos
Masane and her allies prepare for battle; as three twisted Cloneblades move to take the Witchblade by force, thousands of I-Weapons approach to violently complicate matters.

programmes.title: Witchblade
programmes.description:
S01 E24 — Light
The final battle between the Witchblade and the Cloneblades erupts; consumed with madness, Maria leads her Sisters into a clash with Masane; high atop Tokyo Tower, everyone faces their destiny.
